capabilities.name: consolidate_memories
capabilities.description: Consolidate multiple observations into one kairos_memory row (lupo_actor_memory)

capabilities.name: merge_observations
capabilities.description: Merge duplicate observations with identical normalized text for the same actor

capabilities.name: detect_contradictions
capabilities.description: When topic_key matches across kairos_memory rows but text differs, add lupo_edges kairos_contradicts

capabilities.name: promote_to_fact
capabilities.description: Mark consolidated rows verified in context_json when confidence >= 0.8
